metadataRewrite.reason: tippecanoe stored absolute build-machine paths in generator_options; they are now bare file names. No other metadata key, directory or tile byte changed.

nullSemantics: Source unknown 0/-1000/nonfinite measurements remain unknown; null properties are omitted in MVT and must never receive invented height defaults.
limitations: Lower zooms are generalized and may omit dense features; maximum zoom sourceid preservation is explicitly decoded and measured.
MVT has no null property type: source null measurements are absent in tile properties, and must remain unknown in the renderer.
Geometric footprints plus source altitudes support a derived 2.5D extrusion, not photorealistic roof geometry.
Roads cover the full IGC458 envelope, buildings only the declared Paris commune OR GRS sheet envelope.
